model: the exact preregistered 21_to_64_to_32_to_1 RegionCoMembershipV2 with train-only median_MAD normalization

readout_selection.metric: legacy canonical-region evidence topology score for efficient engineering selection

heldout_evaluation.primitive_metric_scope: evaluate singleton and the one globally scene1-selected rule; do not use scene2 primitive evidence to alter the rule

promotion_interpretation: A positive engineering signal requires the frozen scene1-selected rule to improve heldout scene2 IoU and F1 over singleton under deduplicated primitive-instance scoring without reducing primitive topology score. Formal promotion still requires the separate frozen 4train_2validation protocol.
